//compute: PRESENT AND REAL — and this is the preset that needs it MOST, not least. Its default_action is "allow": it grants every action without asking, which is exactly the setting under which a runaway has nothing in its way. Its ceilings are the widest shipped, because "dev" means get out of my way, but they are not absent, because a mission is fire-and-detach and money is spent whether or not anyone approved the spending. Bounds are per-MISSION; an attached chat under this policy is unaffected. A mission that crosses one is finished at status "stuck" with a reason naming the bound.
//compute-fields: maxToolCalls counts envelope-gated tool dispatches — under "allow" very few calls are gated at all, so maxTokens is the bound that actually bites here. maxTokens is BEST-EFFORT: it bounds a mission from the usage its unit reports, and is inert for a unit whose provider reports none. maxTurns is deliberately OMITTED, not forgotten: the dispatcher issues at most two prompt turns per mission, so any ceiling above 1 could never fire. modelAllowlist/backendAllowlist ARE enforced when set, but no shipped preset can guess your model names. "finish_stuck" is the only implemented onExhausted behavior. See docs/development/blueprints/acp/envelope-compute-bounds.md.
